description: This PHP source file defines the ChartsApiController class, which provides API endpoints for generating data visualizations related to projects, investments, costs, and origin statistics within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes methods for retrieving project costs, investments, origin stats, and matcher stats, with access control and data formatting tailored for D3.js charts.

classes.name: ChartsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for project costs, investments, origin statistics, and matcher statistics, with access control and data formatting for visualization.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project object by ID with access control checks.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Retrieves a Call object by ID with access control checks.

methods.name: getMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves a Matcher object by ID with access control checks.

methods.name: projectCostsAction
methods.description: Returns project cost data formatted for D3 charts.

methods.name: projectInvestsAction
methods.description: Returns project investment data formatted for D3 charts.

methods.name: originStatsAction
methods.description: Provides origin statistics data for projects, calls, or matchers.

methods.name: statsMatcherAction
methods.description: Provides statistics related to a specific matcher, such as used amount, available amount, raised amount, and projects count.

methods.name: originMatcherStatsAction
methods.description: Provides origin statistics data for matcher projects.
